name: Crossover
description: The hand-over runs on the diagonal, one ink strong at each opposite corner.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color2); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 0%, transparent 78%); mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 0%, transparent 78%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(315deg, #000 0%, transparent 78%); mask: linear-gradient(315deg, #000 0%, transparent 78%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
